summary: Senior Software Engineer with extensive experience building scalable software, automated pipelines, and testing infrastructure. Proficient in Python, TypeScript, and cloud-integrated systems, bringing over 45 years of Silicon Valley engineering background across software development, diagnostics, and modern AI tooling.

experience.title: Chief Consulting Engineer
bullets: Developed full-stack web applications and AI-powered hiring manager tools using TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Google Cloud Platform (Vertex AI, Firestore).
Built AI-powered transformation applications leveraging Google Gemini and Vertex AI hosted on Vercel.
Utilized modern AI-assisted development tools including Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot to accelerate software engineering workflows.
Designed and implemented backend services using Rust with Axum and Shuttle.rs.

experience.title: Test Engineer III - Embedded Software
bullets: Conducted verification testing for instrument software, handling USB-based updates and regression tests.
Created user manuals on Confluence and API reference documentation using novel Sphinx extensions.
Built remote access solutions for continuous integration and real target testing across all hardware ports and screens.
Calibrated custom test instruments for controlled pneumatic loading and supported cellular radio modem testing.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
bullets: Developed a highly object-oriented test framework in Python 2.7 for automotive OTA firmware update testing.
Built automated integration that mediated between cloud servers and vehicular hardware to check application logs and verify OTA updates.
Implemented concurrent application log tracking during test execution and created extensive YAML configuration files for test parameterization.
Managed source control and workflows using GitLab, Jira, and Confluence on Ubuntu Linux.

experience.title: Sr. Diagnostic Software Engineer
bullets: Developed hardware and software configuration for standalone Production Test stations in the High-Speed Verification division.
Wrote all analog and digital software in Python 2.7 running Debian Linux for BeagleBone Black microcomputers controlling test environments.
Constructed SQL databases and created telemetry event data log visualizations using numpy, pandas, and matplotlib.
Developed environmental data collection and logging synchronous with system-level test logging in Python.

experience.title: Sr. Software Engineer
bullets: Designed timing calibration software for a 192-channel digital ATE instrument using C++ and Python.
Generated custom XML timing patterns via custom Python scripts to support complex digital testing.
Co-designed 4 separate applications of a generic parallel, binary search object.
